name: Bankura

queries.query: Bankura West Bengal official cadastral parcel map land records GIS plot map
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Bankura district land-records page, which directs citizens to the West Bengal Department of Land & Land Reforms Banglarbhumi portal. It also found an official West Bengal GIS ArcGIS REST layer containing Bankura mouza polygons; this is not a parcel layer.

queries.result: Bengali discovery found the Bengali version of the official Bankura district land-records page, which directs users to banglarbhumi.gov.in. No public anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was exposed by the search results.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Bengali first-party discovery followed by bounded TLS-verified GET attempts; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement.

portalsFound.operator: Bankura District Administration, Government of West Bengal
portalsFound.observation: Official district service page says citizens can obtain Department of Land & Land Reforms services and links to banglarbhumi.gov.in; page identifies Bankura as the city scope. This evidences a local/district land-records custodian, but not an open parcel geometry API.

Public ArcGIS Feature Layer named wua.sde.MouzaISRO; polygon geometry, EPSG:4326, query formats include JSON and GeoJSON, and district field includes Bankura. The layer represents mouza/village and development attributes, not cadastral parcels.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified request timed out after 20 seconds from this environment. No retry with disabled verification or bypass was attempted; no viewer JavaScript/configuration or parcel endpoint was obtained.

ArcGIS REST layer metadata was inspected. It reports polygon geometry, EPSG:4326, max record count 2000, and safe administrative/mouza fields including objectid, district, mouza, block and id. No parcel field or parcel semantics are present.
Bounded anonymous query timed out after 30 seconds from this environment. The timeout is not evidence of citywide absence. No geometry was retained.
Equivalent bounded query through the web research fetcher was inaccessible/internal-error; no result was treated as a negative finding.
